tickets.name: Bucket One
tickets.note: Celtics at Magic. Grab a seat, the first bucket is a story we've already read! Robinson versus Carter in the circle, and nobody owns that jump ball! No telling who scores first here, so we've got a man on each side! Tip it, run it, finish it. If Carter gets that jump, that's the whole plan! Richardson is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! If the Celtics get there first, White is who we want firing! Hit one, cover the game. Simple as that, folks!

Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Jackson. Let's go!

tickets.name: Tip-Off Call
tickets.note: Raptors visiting Lakers, and we've got the opening possessions mapped out! Poeltl and Kessler meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! It's up for grabs, and we're holding a ticket on both teams! If Poeltl wins that tip, he goes right back to work, and he's the first look! If the Lakers steal the tip or get the first stop, Thybulle is who we want firing first! Any one of them hits and the whole game is paid for. That's how we like it!
